## Re-measurement at source, replacing the deleted triage comment

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat · session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S` · 2026-09-24T05:48Z · objectui `origin/main` `62597c5` · read with `git show` / `git grep` on `origin/main`, never the working tree. Maintainer instruction in this seat's session, verbatim: 「这些卡你自己分析和排查一下」.

⚠️ The clone is shallow: its oldest commit is `8ed4b95` at 2026-09-20T12:48Z, so commits between filing and that instant are not visible. ⛔ Grading and routing stay with the triage seat; this comment supplies evidence only.

**Verdict: CONFIRMED.** Plus one reading beyond the card.

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:85-86` maps both `col.id` and `col.title` (lower-cased) to the lane id, and `:101` buckets via `labelToColumnId[rawKey.toLowerCase()] ?? rawKey`. So a record matches a lane by id **or** title.
- Reachable by two doors: authored `columns` (a declared input; passed through at `ObjectKanban.tsx:1116-1127`), and, with no `columns`, lanes derived from the groupBy picklist with `title: opt.label` (`:1140-1143`). ⇒ Renaming a picklist option **label** also moves records.
- Deliberate and pinned: the source comment at `index.tsx:68-69`, and `objectKanbanColumnMembers-8071.test.tsx:203-216` (control at `:218`). Nothing on the authoring surface says `title` decides lane membership.
- ⭐ Beyond the card, read from code and not executed: lane titles are localized (`localizeColumn`, `ObjectKanban.tsx:1107-1113`, plus `translateOptions`). So a record whose stored value is an English label lands in its lane for one locale and in "Uncategorized" for another.
- Class: keep or retire the title alias is a product decision; the locale dependence is a user-reachable defect. `Clause-②: no` (retiring narrows; documenting widens nothing). Size S (document) or M (retire, with a migration note).

## 待裁：看板分列时，要不要继续按「列标题」匹配记录 —— `domain:spec` @ objectui 执行席落卡，2026-09-24T13:56Z，session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`

**一句话问题：** 看板把一条记录放进哪一列，除了看列的 id，还会拿记录的值去对「列标题」。所以改个列名、改个下拉选项的显示名，或者换一种界面语言，记录就可能换列，甚至掉进「未分类」。

**背景（实测，objectui `main`，读数见本卡重测评论 `5808461022`）：** `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx` 约 `:85-86` 同时把 `col.id` 和 `col.title`（小写）映射到列 id，`:101` 按这张表分桶。两个入口都能触发：作者写的 `columns`，以及未写 `columns` 时从分组字段下拉选项生成的列（`title: opt.label`）。列标题还会被本地化（`localizeColumn` + `translateOptions`），所以同一条存着英文标签的记录，在一种语言下归位，在另一种语言下掉进「未分类」（读代码得出，⚠️ 未实跑）。这个行为是有意的：源码注释写明「data values (labels like 'In Progress') match column IDs」，并有 pin（`objectKanbanColumnMembers-8071.test.tsx:203-216`）。

**Governing text：** objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1（渲染器不为不合规数据加宽容别名）；spec 只约束列 `id`（objectui#8913），⛔ 没有任何地方声明「标题也是分桶键」。⛔ 本卡不改协议。

**前提与 re-check：** `git grep -n "labelToColumnId\[String(col.title)" origin/main -- packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`（阳性对照：同文件 `labelToColumnId[String(col.id)` 必中）。

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知的后果 |
|---|---|---|
| **A 退休标题匹配** | 只按列 id（= 选项值）分桶；存的是「显示标签」的记录进「未分类」并响亮提示；pin 翻转；附迁移说明 | 改列名、改选项显示名、切换语言都不再移动记录；但历史上存了标签而非值的记录会进「未分类」，需要一次数据修正 |
| **B 保留并写明** | 保留标题匹配，在 `columns` 描述里写明「标题也参与分桶」；另修语言相关的那一半（用未翻译的原始标签匹配） | 存量零变化；但「改列名会移动记录」成为公开承诺的行为 |

**业务含义直译：** A 相当于「按工号分组，不按姓名」—— 改名不影响归属，代价是以前按姓名登记的人要补工号；B 相当于「工号和姓名都认」—— 今天省事，但两个同名的人、或者有人改名，就会被分错组。

**四轴（业务立场）：**
- **项目长远合理性（权重最高）：** 主流看板（Jira、Salesforce Kanban、Notion Board）都只按字段的存储值分组，显示名只是展示层。两年后的平台应当是「值决定归属，标题只负责显示」。A 收窄为单一规则；B 把展示层绑进数据归属。
- **实际业务拉动：** 源码注释说明当初是为了兼容「数据里存的是标签」的情况；⚠️ 本席未测已存数据中有多少记录存的是标签而非选项值（置信缺口）。
- **防 AI 犯错：** AI 写元数据时最易把显示名当值写进数据。A 下这类错误会让记录进「未分类」并被提示，当场可见；B 下它碰巧能工作，直到某天有人改了显示名或换了语言，记录悄悄换列。
- **创业阶段不扩散：** 按「别名立即退休」，标题匹配是一个别名。

```
os-decision-facets
① 长远：A 删除「标题=分桶键」这一隐式第二键（特例 −1）；B 把它写成公开契约
② 拉动：为兼容「存标签」的历史数据而设；存量未测
③ 防 AI：A = 错值进「未分类」并提示（响亮）；B = 改名/换语言后静默换列
④ 不扩散：A remove 别名；B declare-and-maintain
Prior rulings read: "title bucketing" "labelToColumnId" "lane title" → objectui#8913（只收窄 lane id）, 无关于标题的裁决; ADR none; thread: 1
推荐：A（退休标题匹配）· 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否
置信缺口：存量里「存标签而非值」的记录数未测；若大量存在，A 仍成立，但需先提供一次性数据修正脚本再落地
```

**推荐：A**；回退项：B。**裁后执行：** 裁 A ⇒ 本席派一张 dev：分桶只认列 id，未匹配记录进「未分类」并 `console.warn` 点名原值与可选列；翻转 8071 pin（不删）；changeset 写迁移说明；PR 正文给出一次性数据修正的查询方式。裁 B ⇒ 保留匹配但改用未翻译的原始标签（修掉语言相关缺陷），`columns` 描述写明规则，走条款② 复核。

Ruling: batch #222 item 3 · letter A (retire title bucketing — a lane is matched by its id only) · maintainer 「同意」 (chat, director seat summon #29, `session_01EcrTi7s5oDYPHS4Pi7h31d`) 2026-09-24T15:20Z

Director seat, summon #29. Presented with recommendation **A** (fallback B); the maintainer agreed. Thread re-read to its last comment (5815511724) in this act. Protocol first: spec constrains only the lane `id` (objectui#8913), and nothing declares `title` as a bucketing key, so title matching is an undeclared alias.

**Ruled: A.** Kanban buckets a record by lane `id` (= the option value) only.
- `labelToColumnId` stops mapping `col.title` (`plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:85-86`).
- A record that matches no lane goes to "Uncategorized" with a `console.warn` naming the raw value and the available lane ids.
- This removes both doors: authored `columns`, and lanes derived from the groupBy picklist (`title: opt.label`). It also removes the locale-dependent misbucketing, because translated titles no longer decide membership.
- The `objectKanbanColumnMembers-8071.test.tsx:203-216` pin **flips** to assert the id-only rule. ⛔ It is not deleted. Keep the `:218` control.
- The changeset carries a migration note, and the PR body gives the one-off query that finds records storing a label instead of a value.

⛔ B not taken: it would make "renaming a lane moves records" a published behaviour.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this stroke. `priority:p2` and `domain:spec` stand. Clause-②: no (it narrows).

ACCEPT: objectui#10069, delivered by PR objectui#10312 at head `d6d4d02`. Session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`, `domain:spec` @ objectui seat, reviewed against the diff and `origin/main`.

**Executes ruling 5816956837 (A) as written.**

- `bucketCardsIntoColumns` no longer maps `col.title`. The lookup is renamed from `labelToColumnId` to `laneIdByFoldedId`, and it matches the lane **id** only.
  - The existing case folding on the **id** is kept, and a pin checks it. The ruling retires title as a bucketing key; it does not ask to change how the id is folded.
- This one site closes both doors: authored `columns` and picklist-derived lanes (`title: opt.label`). With it, the locale-dependent misbucketing goes away too.
- An unmatched record still lands in Uncategorized. It now emits a `console.warn` naming the groupBy field, the raw value, the record count and the lane ids.
  - The warning fires once per distinct raw value per bucketing pass.
  - Empty values stay silent, since that is the normal uncategorised state.
- The `8071` title pin is **flipped, not deleted**, and its `:218` control is kept. Three more alias pins were flipped the same way:
  - `index.bucket`
  - `8993` row 4
  - `9043` row 4c
- The new `laneIdOnly-10069` test covers four cases through the real `SchemaRenderer`:
  - translated-title invariance
  - case folding
  - warn dedup
  - the picklist door
- **Census:** `bucketCardsIntoColumns` is the only lane-bucketing site. Every host (object-kanban, ListView kanban, ObjectView, the metadata-admin preview) reaches it through `ObjectKanban` / `KanbanRenderer`. Other shapes were reported and left unchanged: swimlanes, the display-only badge lookup, and `plugin-gantt`.
- **Clause-②: no.** The change narrows, per the ruling.
  - The changeset is `minor` on `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, with a migration note.
  - The PR body carries a concrete `$filter nin` query that finds records storing a label instead of a value.
- **Tests:** 69 files, 1067 tests. The plugin-kanban type-check passes, including tests. Reverse verification restored the title mapping: 6 cases went red, exactly the flipped pins and the new invariance rows.

**Not filed (observation):**
- `plugin-gantt`'s `groupByAccessor` keys groups by the option **label**, so two options that share a label would merge. Not reproduced; recorded in the PR's acceptance notes.
- The `prototypeGroupKeys-9043` test header still names `labelToColumnId` as the code measured before this repair. It is historical and is left as is.

**Landing:** flip ready and enqueue once every check on this head is green or an expected skip. ⚠️ The Spec Main Shape Gate is red on every objectui head until objectui#10287 lands.
